results.definition_en: To submit to the will of someone superior, obeying and remaining bound by their command; in relation to God, this may take the form of worship, a religious way, and adherence to its rules.
To judge an action or person, take account of it, and give recompense according to its outcome; as the name of a particular day, it denotes the time when this process takes place.
A financial relation in which goods or money are borrowed or lent, creating for one party an obligation to pay or return them later; sale on credit is a particular form of this relation.
To subdue and humiliate someone by force, enslave or take ownership of them; as a result, the person is dependent and under another's command.
A person's or group's habit established through repetition, ongoing affair, or long-familiar condition and conduct.
A large, orderly inhabited settlement, that is, a city. Its naming is explained by obedience to the authorities established there; this relation is not a necessary feature of a city.

To leave someone to their own conscientious responsibility and word, or to accept their statement as true in a judicial setting; an oath-taker's words may also be assessed according to that person's own intention.

To mark an object or animal so as to leave a lasting, visible physical mark that identifies or distinguishes it; the mark may be made by cauterization, cutting the ear, or notching. The branch also includes the mark itself and, especially, the heated tool used to mark an animal.

To look carefully at signs or traces in a person and infer intuitively their goodness, badness, quality, or condition. The sense rests on interpreting the signs to infer a less visible quality, rather than simply perceiving the signs themselves.

The first rain at the beginning of the year or in early spring that makes vegetation appear on the land and leaves a visible effect. Land that receives this rain and bears its effect is also a related result-state in this branch.

A time, place, or collective gathering designated in advance for people to meet for a shared purpose such as pilgrimage, a market, or something similar. The verb can also mean going to and taking part in that designated gathering.

A person's especially facial, established and marked beauty, pleasant appearance, or grace. It also includes the visible trace this beauty leaves on the person and their being described as beautiful because of it.
A particular plant or small tree whose leaves provide a coloring substance used for dyeing; it is characterized especially by the dye obtained from its leaves.

Worship of a being and a person's devoting themselves to worship. In derived forms, it can also name making a being an object of worship, the worshiped being, and beings regarded as objects of worship.

The proper name for the Creator, together with forms used to address the Creator, make a prayer or plea, express astonishment, and swear an oath. These forms include direct address, use of the name in an oath, and shortened forms produced by dropping sounds or parts.
